# Sizing results

<!-- Generated by tools/rig_sizing.py. Do not edit by hand; regenerate with the three commands shown under each heading. -->

> Three runs: the **rated design case** (300 kg, recommended layout), the **engine-in variant**, and the **recommended engine-out build** as you would actually ride it.

`python3 tools/rig_sizing.py`  (rated design case)

## Sizing run — 300 kg on the rod (130 kg rider standing + 170 kg bike)

Rated payload 300 kg → OK

Everything that rolls: **545 kg**, net CoM **0.49 m** above the pivot (drives hanging below the pivot act as part-counterweight)

### Roll — outer gimbal axis
- Inertia: 352 kg·m²; gravity moment at ±60°: 2249 N·m
- Peak demand (pulling up out of full lean at full accel): **5324 N·m**
- Sector tooth force: 22.2 kN shared by 2 pinions
- 100:1 → per motor 38.1 N·m incl. 1.25× margin + preload (5 kW peak 47.7) OK; 2500 rpm at 150°/s OK
- Runaway into the end stops at full speed: 1207 J → buffers need 10° of travel at ≈6.9 kN·m (hard stops at ±63°, fully crushed at ±73°)
- Holding a 30° lean: 7.0 N·m per motor (rated 15.9) OK

### Pitch — inner gimbal axis
- Inertia: 365 kg·m²; gravity moment at +45° wheelie: 2191 N·m
- Peak demand: **4740 N·m** → per motor 34.2 N·m (5 kW peak 47.7) OK; 2000 rpm at 120°/s

### Yaw — continuous, slew ring + 2 pinions
- Inertia upright 135 kg·m², at 60° lean 385 kg·m²
- Peak demand: **1593 N·m** (incl. 250 N·m slew-ring drag)
- 80:1 → per motor 16.6 N·m (3 kW peak 28.6) OK; 2400 rpm at 180°/s

### Heave — along the stalk (the 'suspension')
- Carriage load 315 kg → static 3.09 kN; peak at 1.5 g onset **8.03 kN**
- 20 mm lead screw: peak 28.4 N·m, 35.5 incl. margin (5 kW peak 47.7) OK; static 10.9 N·m, or 2.7 N·m with the air spring carrying 75 %
- 0.6 m/s → 1800 rpm; stroke 200 mm (±100)

### Structure
- Base/anchor design overturning moment (1.5 × peak axis torque): **8.0 kN·m**
- Stalk (114.3×8 CHS equivalent) bending at peak: 80 MPa → S355 safety factor 4.4

### Envelope (pivot 0.60 m above floor)
- Rider's head swings 1.67 m sideways at full lean; bar end 1.17 m
- Rear fender at full wheelie: 1.27 m behind the axis, 0.39 m off the floor
- Keep-out radius **2.0 m** → fenced cell ≈ 4.6 m × 4.6 m
- Minimum ceiling **3.0 m**; seat height above floor ≈ 1.55 m

### Why there's no overhead fall-arrest line
- A ceiling tether to the rider's chest pays out at **3.6 m/s** during an ordinary 150°/s whip. Self-retracting lifelines lock at ≈1.5 m/s, so one would yank the rider mid-whip.
